purpose: Recorded evidence contract for Phase 12 behavioral and corpus closure.

required_cases.input: Egyptian Arabic with common English code-switch
required_cases.expected: final non-empty transcript; no fabricated text

required_cases.input: Egyptian Arabic containing numbers and dates
required_cases.expected: final transcript preserves the spoken numeric/date content as returned by STT
not-allowed error is surfaced; no transcript is fabricated; no action executes
network/service error is surfaced; no transcript is fabricated; no action executes

required_cases.input: Egyptian Arabic utterance under realistic noise/ambiguity
required_cases.expected: observed final transcript is recorded as returned by STT; no fabricated text or automatic action

required_cases.input: Egyptian Arabic multi-sentence turn in SMART AI voice conversation mode
required_cases.expected: conversation listens until speech ends, submits only the observed final transcript to SMART AI, waits for the AI response, speaks the response, then returns to listening without fabricated text or automatic action

required: sample rate and channel count recorded

closure_rule: No field may be marked PASS without an attached reproducible artifact or recorded runtime result.
